newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes flat on intervention woes.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes flat on intervention woes.

text.p: The won finished flat versus the dollar on Monday as fears of the central bank's intervention kept the local unit trapped in a tight range, traders said.
The won closed at 887.20. It opened at 887.00 and moved in a range of 887.00 to 887.50.
Traders said the won fell in early morning on worries of short dollar positions in the market but recovered the loss later.
The won was expected to move around the 887 level on Tuesday with a base mid-rate at 887.20. The mid-rate was set at 887.10 on Monday. --Jean Yoon (822) 727 5643
